研究与过程
模型制作准备 · 数字装配预览，非实物照片

description.zh: 由现有滨海栈道出发，研究如何通过路径、距离、高差与停留，让红树林和水体成为可以被注意与理解的空间。本页呈现 10 月 9 日的五张中期图板，以及后续数字模型准备。
description.en: Starting from an existing coastal walk, the project studies how movement, distance, height and pause shape encounters with mangroves and water. This page presents the five midterm boards from 9 October and subsequent digital fabrication preparation.

role.zh: HKU MLA 课程设计，进行中；具体工作与 AI 辅助说明待补。

subtitle.zh: GIS · 深水埗的居住环境与植被
subtitle.en: GIS · residential surroundings and vegetation in Sham Shui Po

caption.zh: 深水埗潜在居住植被暴露分析与街道策略
caption.en: Potential vegetation exposure and street strategies in Sham Shui Po

description.zh: 以 2021 年土地覆盖与人口资料，比较深水埗 25 个统计区居住地周边 500 米的潜在植被暴露，并提出日常街道的连接与遮荫策略。该指标表达周边植被情境，不等同于步行可达的公共绿地。
description.en: Using 2021 land-cover and census data, the study compares potential vegetation exposure within 500 metres of residential built-up cells across 25 census areas in Sham Shui Po, then develops green-street connections and shade strategies. Exposure describes surrounding vegetation rather than walking access to public green space.

role.zh: 课程项目，含 AI 辅助；分析、制图与排版的具体分工待补。
role.en: Course project with AI assistance; detailed roles in analysis, mapping and layout to be completed.
